Several Benefits of Student Growth
Percentiles:
■ Understandable at conceptual level which is
 critical for generating meaningful discussions
■ Provides defensible and actionable answers to
 basic questions about academic growth
■ Not overly dependent on measurement
 properties of underlying instrument
■ Readily supports secondary analysis at district
 and school level
